gen-megrim-gf-anek-gujarati: Anek Gujarati keeps its lowercase nearly as tall as its capitals, with a gaping c opening and a friendly, approachable manner. Megrim does sharp, futuristic display work; the body simply gets on with reading.
gen-megrim-gf-anek-gurmukhi: Futuristic, Megrim sketches every letter with a pencil that never presses harder. Anek Gurmukhi fills in with open-handed curves and big counters in every small letter, so the sharp heading has something generous beside it.
gen-megrim-gf-anek-kannada: Megrim ends every stroke at a measured thickness, with a c as open as a bent paperclip. And the shared strength is height: Anek Kannada lifts its x-height like squared-off woodblock type, echoing the skyward lines above.
gen-megrim-gf-anek-latin: Sharp lines, futuristic attitude: Megrim gives arches and stems matching weight. Anek Latin brings lowercase that nearly reaches the capitals, shapes held open rather than curled shut, giving the sharp heading a steady partner.
gen-megrim-gf-anek-malayalam: Unshaded, constant strokes make Megrim look angular and properly futuristic. Anek Malayalam stays clean and contemporary, with almost no gap between x-height and caps and curve tips that never touch.
gen-megrim-gf-anek-odia: A c as open as a bent paperclip defines Megrim. Megrim excels at angular, constant-stroke display letters, while Anek Odia is best at unsealed rounds and capitals barely above lowercase.
gen-megrim-gf-anek-tamil: Futuristic from the first line, Megrim draws everything with a constant-width pen stroke and a c as open as a bent paperclip. Megrim handles sharp display; Anek Tamil handles big, round, half-unwrapped lowercase.
gen-megrim-gf-anek-telugu: Anek Telugu reads in wide, tall bowls and rounds left unsealed like an unlatched hook, friendly and clean. The standout is Megrim, where curves and straights share a single width.
gen-megrim-gf-anuphan: Anuphan reads in big round bowls and open curves with clear gaps. Megrim, angular and futuristic, has no thick-thin modulation and a c as open as a bent paperclip, which sets the two apart.
gen-megrim-gf-arimo: Angular to the bone, Megrim draws every stroke at a measured thickness, with a skyward x-height line. Arimo is where the pair is strongest: a tall mean line and spacious terminal gaps in its rounded glyphs.
